attribution: Attribution is not legally required under CC0; this project credits Tatoeba.org and its contributors for the source corpus.
translationPolicy: Examples are shipped in English only. No Chinese translations are imported or generated.
selectionPolicy: Selector v2 chooses at most one deterministic English sentence per covered CET-6 headword; exact whole-word match; 6-18 tokens preferred, with only clear 19-20 token exceptions; 8-14 tokens and 45-120 characters preferred; simple punctuation; proper-noun, rare-context, topic-neutrality, standalone-context, and target-position scoring; severe sensitive-content rejection; no runtime network access.
